description: Lavinprognoser: sluttningar i fjällen (lutningsgrader) is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by lavinprognoser.se. The product is taken by a classification of a subset of Lantmäteriet's DEM 2 m (NH 2+, classification level 3, which is based on laser scanned data) for use in the Swedish Environmental Protection Agency's Avalanche Forecasting Service. Where drawing is missing, Lantmäteriet's DEM 50 m has been used. Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "Avalanche forecasts: slopes in the mountains (degrees of slope)" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
